top_issues.issue: Blurry horizontal smear noise on the dark rock

top_issues.suggested_direction: Give each world its own facet response: sharp specular facets for ice, a subtle iridescent tint shift for Maelis.

top_issues.issue: Title backdrop is flat lit rock, not a dark shaft with warmth rising from below
top_issues.why: Reference 01 is about darkness above and glow below. Here the wordmark floats over evenly lit brown blocks, so the hierarchy has no 'descent'.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Darken the area behind the wordmark toward black and push a warm gradient or bloom up from the bottom edge, so the type sits in void and the light comes from beneath.

top_issues.issue: Very small secondary HUD text
top_issues.why: Labels like FUEL/HULL values, LUMENS, CARGO and the bar numbers are about 8-9px grey and hard to read at a glance, which hurts readability of play.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Raise the minimum label size by 1-2px and the contrast slightly. Make the fuel bar thicker, since it's the critical gauge.

top_issues.issue: Ending page body text is underweighted
top_issues.why: Thin italic grey text on near-black is low-contrast, and the frame below the text is unused, so the 'core floods with light' finale feels thin.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Raise body contrast and size a touch, and let a faint warm core glow sit low in the frame to echo reference 07's light.

top_issues.issue: Shop buttons are generic web UI
top_issues.why: The grey SELL buttons don't share the bronze-bracket language of the panel.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Give the buttons the same amber hairline and corner treatment as the panel frame.

top_issues.issue: Glow is clipped to the tile square instead of blooming
